sources.name: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database — Debt collection • Medical debt
sources.use: Complaint counts by state, month, issue, company response, and ZIP (2021–Aug 2026).
sources.limits: Complaints are not a statistical sample and do not establish wrongdoing. Most name a debt collector, not the hospital or provider that billed.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-year estimates
sources.use: Population (B01003), uninsured (B27010), poverty (B17001), median income (B19013), disability (B18101), and rent burden ≥30% of income (B25070).
sources.limits: Survey estimates with margins of error; small counties are less precise.

sources.name: CMS Hospital General Information
sources.use: Hospital name, ZIP, type, ownership, and emergency services.
sources.limits: Map points use Census ZIP-area (ZCTA) centroids, not street addresses.

sources.name: IRS Form 990 e-file XML — Schedule H (Hospitals)
sources.use: Reported financial-assistance income limits, publicity, and extraordinary collection actions permitted before reasonable efforts to determine eligibility.
sources.limits: Self-reported filing answers, not audited practice. Returns filed in 2025–2026 (mostly tax year 2024). Facility links to CMS use ZIP and name similarity.

sources.name: Hospital price-transparency machine-readable files (via each site's cms-hpt.txt)
sources.use: Gross charge, discounted cash price, and payer-negotiated rates for six shoppable services at up to four linked nonprofit hospitals per state.
sources.limits: A bounded sample, not every hospital. Files vary in format and completeness; posted prices are not what a given patient owes.

sources.name: Census ZCTA gazetteer and ZCTA-to-county relationship file
sources.use: Approximate hospital points and ZIP-to-county assignment for complaints.
sources.limits: ZIP codes and ZCTAs differ; masked 3-digit complaint ZIPs cannot be placed in a county.

sources.name: us-atlas (Census cartographic boundaries, 1:10m)
sources.limits: 2017 county boundaries: Connecticut's 2022 planning regions are not drawn.
